---
title: "Card payments variance refresh"
output: html_document
---

Alternative to the GitHub Actions schedule: deploy this document to Posit
Connect and give it a weekly schedule. Set `CARDVAR_BOARD=r2` and the four
`R2_*` variables (a read-and-write R2 token) in the content's Vars panel.

Deploy from the project root. The file list keeps the bundle to what the pipeline
needs: no local pins, downloads, targets store or `.Renviron` secrets.

    files <- c("refresh_connect.Rmd", "_targets.R", "R", "config", "app/R/storage.R",
               "app/R/shared.R", "DESCRIPTION", "renv.lock")
    rsconnect::deployApp(appDir = ".", appFiles = files, appPrimaryDoc = "refresh_connect.Rmd",
                         appName = "card-payments-variance-refresh",
                         envVars = c("CARDVAR_BOARD", "R2_ACCOUNT_ID", "R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
                                     "R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", "R2_BUCKET", "R2_PREFIX"))

```{r refresh, message = FALSE}
targets::tar_make(reporter = "silent")
release <- targets::tar_read(release)
```

```{r summary, results = "asis"}
cat(release$summary_md)
```
